subject: Mutual plan draft: procurement runway and signature gate
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@edgewave.io>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@edgewave.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: mutual plan draft & procurement runway

Hi Samir / Laura — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and an attached draft (Edgewave_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) so we have a working Mutual Action Plan to iterate on. I pulled the items we discussed and proposed dates so we can align on a realistic procurement runway.

High-level proposal (first pass):
- Target close (commercial go-live): 2028-06-30
- Contract signature deadline (to meet target): 2028-06-20 (allows 7–10 business days for PO processing and onboarding kickoff)

Key milestones & owners (draft):
- Security questionnaire (customer to review answers) — Action: Redwood to return completed questionnaire by 2028-04-21 — Owner: Olga Petrov (SE)
- Architecture walkthrough / integration checklist — Target: 2028-04-28 — Owner: Olga
- SOC 2 evidence upload & review — Target: 2028-05-10 — Owner: Ben Carter (Solutions)
- Contract redlines & legal signoff — Start: 2028-05-15; Target complete: 2028-06-05 — Owner: Redwood Legal + Edgewave Legal
- Procurement PO submission — Target: 2028-06-10 (edgewave) / Signature by 2028-06-20

Dependencies we flagged:
- Final contract language on data residency & retention (Edgewave legal input required)
- Security attestation file (SOC2 artifacts) to be delivered by Edgewave procurement/security team
- Any custom integration work outside standard connectors (may affect onboarding timing)

Attachments: Edgewave_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (milestones with dates), Edgewave_SOW_draft_v1.docx (SOW high level)

Next steps I propose:
1) Samir/Laura: review the attached MAP and confirm whether the 06-20 signature deadline gives procurement enough runway.
2) Laura/Procurement: confirm expected PO submission & approval cadence (procurement contact in cc or separate) and earliest feasible signature date.
3) Internal (Olga + Ben): we’ll produce the security questionnaire answers and a 1-page integration checklist by next week.
4) Schedule a 30-minute procurement sync if needed — suggest week of 2028-04-16.

If that looks reasonable I’ll update the MAP accordingly (versioning it in the shared Drive link). Thanks — looking forward to closing this out with you.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samir Patel <samir@edgewave.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@edgewave.io>
Cc: procure@edgewave.io
Date: 2028-04-12T09:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: mutual plan draft & procurement runway

Thanks Marcus — good recap. A couple quick items from our side after reviewing the initial draft: we’d like to try to compress the commercial close by a couple weeks if possible. Can you confirm whether Redwood can target a commercial close of 2028-06-15 (i.e., signed contract in early June)?

Questions / constraints from Edgewave procurement & legal:
- Legal turnaround: our legal team typically needs ~7 business days to review redlines but we can try to fast-track for priority deals.
- Procurement windows: we have a financial cutover on 2028-06-20; ideally the signed contract clears internal vendor onboarding before that date. If Redwood can accept 06-15 as target close, we’ll do our best to submit PO paperwork sooner.

Can we get a sense from Redwood on the shortest practical contract-signature deadline you can accept while still meeting onboarding/implementation SLAs? Would 06-05 signature be feasible on your side to meet a 06-15 commercial close?

Also include me on the procurement sync; I’ll ask procurement to provide expected PO processing lead times. Happy to join a short call.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform, Edgewave
samir@edgewave.io

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@edgewave.io>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@edgewave.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-13T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: mutual plan draft & procurement runway

Hi Samir — appreciate the fast feedback. Quoting your question about the earliest signature date: "Would 06-05 signature be feasible on your side to meet a 06-15 commercial close?"

Short answer: yes, we can make the timeline work provided a few dependencies align on your end. To be explicit, here’s what we need to hit a signature-by-2028-06-05 target and operational go-live on ~2028-06-15: 

Updated milestone plan (with revised targets to compress schedule):
- Security questionnaire (Redwood answers) -> due 2028-04-21 — Owner: Olga Petrov
- Architecture walkthrough & integration checklist -> complete 2028-04-25 — Owner: Olga
- SOC 2 artifacts: Edgewave to confirm availability by 2028-05-05 — Owner: Edgewave Security
- Contract negotiation & redlines -> legal exchange window 2028-05-08 to 2028-05-22 (we’ll aim to limit to one negotiated pass) — Owner: Redwood Legal + Edgewave Legal
- Procurement PO submission -> Edgewave target 2028-05-29 (earliest)
- Contract signature target -> 2028-06-05 (must be signed by both parties)
- Onboarding & configuration kickoff -> 2028-06-07

Notes and risks:
- If Edgewave legal requires multiple rounds of redlines beyond the 05-22 cutoff, the signature date will slip. Please confirm legal availability for the 05-08 to 05-22 window.
- Any custom engineering work not scoped in the attached SOW will push the go-live date; we should flag those items in the next MAP version.

Olga — can you attach the one-page integration checklist and confirm the security questionnaire delivery date? Priyom, Ben — we might need a short CS/solutions pre-kickoff if integration work is custom; can you be available the week of 05-06 for a 60-minute technical alignment if needed?

Proposed next step: 30-minute procurement & legal sync on Tue 2028-04-16 at 10:00 AM PT to confirm PO cadence and legal availability. Samir/Laura/procure@edgewave.io — can you confirm?

I’ve updated the attached MAP to v0.3 with the revised dates. If procurement can commit to earliest PO submission ~2028-05-29 we’ll be in good shape for the 06-05 signature target.

Thanks — I’ll keep the MAP live in Drive and version any changes.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@edgewave.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@edgewave.io>
Cc: procure@edgewave.io
Date: 2028-04-15T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: mutual plan draft & procurement runway

Thanks Marcus — I briefed procurement and they indicated that aiming for a 2028-06-05 signature is feasible provided we lock down redlines in mid-May. I looped procurement on this thread (procure@edgewave.io) to confirm PO timeline and will introduce our procurement lead if needed.

We confirm availability for the Tue 2028-04-16 10:00 AM PT sync. Sending a calendar invite shortly.

—Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Vendor Ops, Edgewave
laura.chen@edgewave.io
